events.title: Lake Kawaguchi
events.description: One of the Fuji Five Lakes—mirror views of Mt. Fuji, lakeside promenades and cruises from the north shore.

events.title: Mt. Fuji Panoramic Ropeway
events.description: A 3-minute ride up Mt. Tenjō to the Fujimidai lookout with sweeping views over Lake Kawaguchi and Fuji.

events.title: Oishi Park (North Shore)
events.description: Flower-lined lakeside path framing Mt. Fuji—famous for lavender in summer and blazing foliage in autumn.
